1.w: And Benjamin begat Bela his firstborn, Ashbel the second, and Aharah the third,

2.w: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.

3.w: And the sons of Bela: Addar, and Gera, and Abihud,

4.w: and Abishua, and Naaman, and Ahoah,

5.w: and Gera, and Shephuphan, and Huram.

6.w: And these [are] the sons of Ehud—these were the heads of fathers of those dwelling in Geba, and they carried them away to Manahath:

7.w: Even Naaman, and Ahijah, and Gera. He carried them away, and he begat Uzza and Ahihud.

8.w: And Shaharaim begat in the land of Moab, after he had sent away Hushim and Baara his wives.

9.w: And he begat by Hodesh his wife: Jobab, and Zibia, and Mesha, and Malcam,

10.w: and Jeuz, and Sachiah, and Mirmah. These [were] his sons, heads of fathers.

11.w: And by Hushim he begat: Abitub and Elpaal.

12.w: And the sons of Elpaal: Eber, and Misham, and Shemed (he built Ono and Lod and its daughters),

13.w: and Beriah and Shema (they [were] heads of fathers of those dwelling in Aijalon; they drove out those dwelling in Gath),

15.w: and Zebadiah, and Arad, and Eder,

16.w: and Michael, and Ispah, and Joha—the sons of Beriah,

17.w: and Zebadiah, and Meshullam, and Hizki, and Heber,

18.w: and Ishmerai, and Jizliah, and Jobab—the sons of Elpaal,

19.w: and Jakim, and Zichri, and Zabdi,

20.w: and Elienai, and Zillethai, and Eliel,

21.w: and Adaiah, and Beraiah, and Shimrath—the sons of Shimei,

22.w: and Ishpan, and Eber, and Eliel,

23.w: and Abdon, and Zichri, and Hanan,

24.w: and Hananiah, and Elam, and Antothijah,

25.w: and Iphdeiah, and Penuel—the sons of Shashak,

26.w: and Shamsherai, and Shehariah, and Athaliah,

27.w: and Jaareshiah, and Elijah, and Zichri—the sons of Jeroham.

28.w: These [were] heads of fathers by their generations; these heads dwelt in Jerusalem.

29.w: And [Jeiel] the father of Gibeon dwelt at Gibeon, and the name of his wife [was] Maacah;

30.w: and his firstborn son [was] Abdon, and Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Nadab,

31.w: and Gedor, and Ahio, and Zecher.

32.w: And Mikloth begat Shimeah. And they also dwelt alongside their brothers in Jerusalem with their brothers.

33.w: And Ner begat Kish, and Kish begat Saul, and Saul begat Jonathan, and Malchishua, and Abinadab, and Esh-baal.

34.w: And the son of Jonathan: Merib-baal, and Merib-baal begat Micah.

35.w: And the sons of Micah: Pithon, and Melech, and Tarea, and Ahaz.

36.w: And Ahaz begat Jehoadah, and Jehoadah begat Alemeth and Azmaveth and Zimri, and Zimri begat Moza,

37.w: and Moza begat Binea, Raphah his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son.

38.w: And Azel had six sons, and these [were] their names: Azrikam, Bocheru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan—all these the sons of Azel.

39.w: And the sons of Eshek his brother: Ulam his firstborn, Jeush the second, and Eliphelet the third.

40.w: And the sons of Ulam were mighty men of valor, bending the bow and multiplying sons and grandsons—a hundred and fifty. All these [were] sons of Benjamin.
